INSERT INTO dbo.prospect_search_runs
(
  search_id,
  execution_id,
  industry,
  location,
  prospect_type,
  ideal_customer_type,
  status,
  created_at
)
OUTPUT INSERTED.search_id,
  'query executed successfully' AS message
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  $7,
  GETDATE()
);

UPDATE dbo.prospect_search_runs
SET 
  error_type = $2,
  error_message = $3,
  status = $4,
  updated_at = GETDATE()
WHERE search_id = $1
